source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Qleaner marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: Jack’s Cleaner × Space Queen
Breeder: TGA Subcool Seeds
THC Content: 20–26%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Terpinolene , Limonene , Pinene
Primary Flavors: Citrus, Sweet, Tropical, Herbal
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Early to Mid October
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 16–20 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Qleaner is one of the more intriguing cultivars to emerge from the boutique breeding movement led by the late Subcool of TGA Genetics. Known for his emphasis on vibrant terpene expression and bold genetic pairings, Subcool created this hybrid by blending two highly aromatic lines—Jack’s Cleaner and Space Queen. The result is a plant that captures the electric cerebral energy of classic sativa genetics while presenting a surprisingly smooth and layered flavor profile.

What sets this cultivar apart is the way its effects unfold. Instead of producing a chaotic surge of stimulation, the experience tends to feel focused and mentally expansive. Combined with its bright citrus-dominant terpene profile and generous resin production, the plant has developed a loyal following among enthusiasts who appreciate energetic hybrids with strong aromatic presence.
Genetics and Lineage

The lineage behind Qleaner reflects two distinct but complementary cannabis families. One parent, Jack’s Cleaner, is a powerful sativa-leaning hybrid developed by TGA Genetics from Jack Herer and a Pluton lineage. This strain became well known for its sharp citrus aroma and exceptionally clear-headed psychoactive effects.

Jack’s Cleaner contributes much of the hybrid’s stimulating mental character. Its terpene profile often expresses intense lemon and herbal notes, which are strongly represented in the offspring. The genetic influence of Jack Herer within this lineage also introduces uplifting cerebral qualities associated with classic haze hybrids.

The second parent, Space Queen, was created from a cross between Cinderella 99 and Romulan . Cinderella 99 is famous for its tropical fruit aroma and energetic mental stimulation, while Romulan contributes physical relaxation and strong structural stability to the plant.

By crossing these two terpene-rich lines, Subcool produced a hybrid that combines the bright citrus intensity of Jack’s Cleaner with the fruit-forward complexity and structural strength of Space Queen. The resulting cultivar often displays vigorous growth, high resin production, and a terpene profile dominated by citrus and herbal notes.
Effects and Experience

The experience produced by Qleaner tends to begin with a noticeable burst of mental clarity. Shortly after consumption, many individuals feel a sharp uplift in mood accompanied by heightened awareness and focus. Thoughts often move quickly, and creative ideas may feel easier to explore.

As the experience develops, the strain’s energizing mental effects remain dominant while a mild physical relaxation gradually appears. This physical component helps stabilize the stimulation, preventing the experience from becoming overly intense or jittery. The balance between alertness and calm makes the hybrid particularly engaging.

Later stages of the experience often transition into a steady state of relaxed mental focus. The initial surge of stimulation softens into a comfortable clarity that allows users to remain productive while enjoying a subtle sense of well-being. Because of this progression, many enthusiasts prefer this weed strain for daytime activities or creative work.
Medical Benefits

Patients exploring cannabis for therapeutic purposes sometimes gravitate toward sativa-dominant hybrids like Qleaner because of their uplifting mental qualities. The stimulating cerebral effects may help counter fatigue and improve motivation, making the strain appealing for daytime symptom management.

Mood support represents another potential mmj benefit . The clear-headed euphoria associated with the strain may help reduce feelings of stress or emotional heaviness. Because the experience tends to remain mentally functional, many users find it easier to maintain focus while experiencing relief.

In addition to its mental benefits, the mild physical relaxation that develops during the later stages of the experience may help ease minor muscular tension. Although the strain does not typically produce strong sedation, the gentle body comfort can contribute to an overall sense of relaxation.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The terpene profile of Qleaner is one of its most striking features. When the dried flower is handled, a bright burst of citrus aroma often dominates the scent. Lemon peel and sweet orange notes frequently appear at the forefront of the fragrance.

Terpinolene plays a major role in shaping the aromatic character, contributing herbal brightness and subtle floral undertones. Limonene enhances the citrus elements, while caryophyllene introduces a faint peppery warmth that adds depth to the scent.

During consumption, the flavor tends to evolve in layers. The inhale often delivers strong lemon and citrus notes accompanied by faint tropical sweetness. As the vapor or smoke settles on the palate, subtle herbal spice and mild earthiness appear, creating a balanced and refreshing finish.
Growing Information

Cultivating Qleaner typically involves managing the vigorous growth associated with its sativa heritage. The plant often develops a tall structure with strong lateral branches extending from the main stem. Growers frequently use training techniques such as topping or low-stress training to maintain canopy control.

Indoor flowering cycles generally complete within eight to nine weeks. During this period, the plant produces elongated buds that gradually become coated with resinous trichomes. Adequate airflow is important because the plant can develop dense foliage when left untrained.

Outdoor cultivation can produce impressive yields in climates with warm temperatures and ample sunlight. When grown outdoors, the plant may reach considerable height and produce numerous flowering sites along its branches. Proper spacing and pruning help ensure even light distribution and healthy growth.
FAQ
What kind of strain is Qleaner? Qleaner is a sativa-dominant hybrid created by crossing Jack’s Cleaner with Space Queen.
How strong is Qleaner? THC levels typically range between 20% and 26%, making it a relatively potent modern hybrid.
What does Qleaner taste like? The flavor often includes bright citrus notes, lemon zest, tropical fruit sweetness, and subtle herbal spice.
Is Qleaner good for daytime use? Yes. Many consumers prefer it during the day because its stimulating mental effects promote focus and creativity.
Is Qleaner easy to grow? The plant can be moderately challenging due to its vigorous growth, but experienced growers often achieve strong yields with proper training.
Final Thoughts on Qleaner

Qleaner stands as a compelling example of the creative breeding philosophy that defined TGA Genetics. By combining the citrus intensity of Jack’s Cleaner with the aromatic complexity of Space Queen, Subcool produced a hybrid capable of delivering both powerful effects and vibrant flavor.

The strain’s terpene profile offers a bright mix of citrus, herbal spice, and faint tropical sweetness, while its effects emphasize mental clarity and energetic focus. This balance has helped the hybrid attract enthusiasts who value stimulating cannabis experiences that remain comfortable and manageable.

For growers, the plant offers strong yield potential and vigorous growth when cultivated under proper conditions. For consumers, the experience provides a lively blend of creativity and calm. Together, these qualities allow Qleaner to remain a memorable and respected cultivar within modern cannabis breeding .
